description: This is an abstract PHP class named 'View' within the SuiteCRM project, responsible for rendering templates related to PDF configuration in the administration module. It contains methods to set up Smarty template variables, retrieve button HTML, and get available PDF engines.

classes.name: View
classes.description: An abstract class extending BaseView that provides methods for setting up template variables, rendering buttons, and retrieving available PDF rendering engines within the administration PDF module.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Initializes Smarty template variables with localization strings, configuration, and error messages, and logs a warning if PDF settings are absent.

methods.name: getButtons
methods.description: Renders and returns the HTML for cancel and save buttons using a Smarty template.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns an associative array mapping available PDF engine identifiers to their translated names.
